summary: works out tips and splits bills: the tip at a percentage or a level of service, the total, and each person's share to the cent.
guide: Tag skeletonword to work out a tip or split a bill. Give the bill as a number in its own currency; the agent never converts currencies.

commands.name: tip
commands.summary: The tip and the total for a bill, at a percentage or a level of service.

args.name: bill
args.note: the bill before the tip, in its currency

args.name: percent
args.note: the tip as a percentage of the bill; left out, the level of service sets it

args.name: service
args.note: the level of service when no percent is given: good when left out

commands.name: split
commands.summary: A bill and its tip split between people, each share to the cent.

args.name: bill
args.note: the bill before the tip, in its currency

args.name: people
args.note: how many people share the bill, one or more

args.name: percent
args.note: the tip as a percentage of the bill; left out, the level of service sets it

args.name: service
args.note: the level of service when no percent is given: good when left out

units.summary: Tips, totals and shares, to the cent.

functions.name: percent
rules: The percentage for a level of service, from tip-presets.json: poor 10, fair 15, good 18, great 22.

functions.name: breakdown
rules: The tip is the bill times the percentage over 100, to the cent; the total is the bill plus the tip.
A negative bill, a percentage outside 0 to 100, or fewer than one person is refused.

functions.name: shares
rules: Shares are whole cents and sum to the total; the first shares take the cents left over.

types.name: TipBreakdown
types.note: A bill with its tip worked out.

fields.name: perPerson
fields.note: the total over the people, to the cent
